lastCompletedStory.title: Supervisor poll loop completion-detects via worker-report.json as the canonical path; parseAnySentinel demoted

nextStoryContext: US-002 demoted parseAnySentinel for the implementer path: the poll loop comment and file header now explicitly document worker-report.json as canonical and the sentinel as human-corroboration only. Two new tests (AC3 + AC2) confirm the demotion. No logic change was needed since the if (readWorkerReport !== undefined) / else structure already gave the report priority. US-003 documents the change in the implementer agent prompt (both template and runtime copies + vendor regen).

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-002 touched only internal TypeScript files (loop.ts, loop.test.ts). No external library API was exercised.
